data.title: Bitcoin Stuck at $63,000, Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin Down up to 2% on Weak Friday
data.description: Cryptocurrencies struggle despite strong ETF inflows and hawkish Fed tone on interest rates. Analysts expect possible pullback to $60,000-$61,000 range and a fall below could trigger prolonged weakness.
data.author: Khyathi Dalal
